newsitem.title: UK: U.K. Dec North Sea output posts '96 record - APR.
newsitem.headline: U.K. Dec North Sea output posts '96 record - APR.

text.p: U.K. North Sea oil output rose by 62,444 barrels per day (bpd) in December to reach 2,740,671 bpd, setting a new record for 1996, the Aberdeen Petroleum Report (APR) said on Monday.

A recovery in production at Enterprise's Nelson field, which gained nearly 19,000 bpd to 181,790 bpd, and rising output from Amerada Hess's Scott and recently on stream Telford satellite, took the monthly average above the previous record set in November.
Scott/Telford added 14,159 bpd to 177,683 bpd, APR said.
Increased production at Chevron's Alba and Shell Expro's Brent also swelled the total.
"All four Brent field platforms contributed to a 194,000 barrel daily output which was 5,000 bpd above the November average," APR said.

Chevron's Alba gained nearly 6,000 bpd to 88,517 bpd and as a result of second phase development was "reported to be running ahead of 100,000 bpd with only a few days of the month (January) remaining," it added.
